subject: planner: MaxCountAfterAccess should not go below CountAfterAccess (#63186)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent in `pkg/planner/core/stats.go`. The change factors `CountAfterAccess` lower-bound logic into `adjustCountAfterAccess()` and, crucially, ensures `MaxCountAfterAccess >= CountAfterAccess` after `CountAfterAccess` is raised to align with `ds.StatsInfo().RowCount`. This matches downstream planner assumptions (e.g. skyline pruning risk-ratio logic in `pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go`) and prevents invalid "upper bound" states (risk ratio < 1). No Blocker/High correctness/SQL-semantics/session/txn/visibility issues found; upstream/master retains the same logic.
